decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program uses the firm's core clinical competence and is reimbursed by health insurers, so it is likely to continue.
The carpentry workshop provides meaningful sheltered employment and builds on the firm's production know-how, so it is a stable part of the workshop offer.
Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's psychiatric services and is reimbursable, though its small scale leaves some risk.
Senior living counseling is cheap to run, sits close to core eldercare and channels clients to the firm's facilities.
The retail shop supports inclusion and sales of workshop products, but its retail costs make it somewhat more vulnerable.
Senior meal delivery complements the firm's eldercare and uses existing kitchen capacity, though as a new, low-visibility service it carries some early-stage risk.
